checklist.note: No directives aimed at the reading model; SKILL.md/sextant.md are legitimate agent-role instructions, not injected overrides.
shot.mjs only screenshots a local file:// page and writes a local PNG; no network send of repo/user data.
No keys/tokens/credentials found in any material file.
No rm -rf/force-push/dd/chmod-777; scripts only mkdirSync/readFileSync/writeFileSync on given paths.
All JS is plain readable Node/browser code; no base64/hex payloads or eval of decoded blobs.
Template loads React/ReactFlow/elkjs from esm.sh and fonts from Google Fonts CDN — expected, documented rendering deps, not a hidden fetch-and-run.
No reads of ~/.ssh, ~/.aws, .env, keychain, or cookie stores anywhere in the scripts.
No sudo, setuid, or cron/profile/launch-agent persistence edits.
